name: v27-03-no-group-solo-blob
objective: v2.7 plan 03 live row (D7), no model. A one-on-one chat that holds a story blob written before stories were group-only shows the make-a-group card and nothing else runs: no audit, no injection in a dry-run prompt, no HUD; selecting a story there is refused; the card's button (confirmed) makes a group of the story's own cast, binds it to the story and opens it, and the new group chat plays the story. Cleanup deletes the created group, its chat and its binding. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-03-no-group-solo-blob.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088.

requires.why: the sun-ruins cast (DM Narrator, Arin, Ponticius, Luke) must exist as cards for the make-a-group button to create a full group; no model call is made

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (ctx.groupId) throw new Error('solo_chat did not leave the group'); if (rt.getSnapshot().ready) throw new Error('a story plays in a one-on-one chat with nothing selected'); if (rt.getSnapshot().noGroup) throw new Error('an ordinary one-on-one chat shows the make-a-group card'); globalThis.__v2703 = { soloChat: ctx.chatId, auditsBefore: rt.getExtractionAudits().length }; return globalThis.__v2703;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator = { version: 6, chatId: ctx.chatId, selectedStoryId: 'sun-ruins', stories: {} }; await ctx.saveMetadata?.(); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.loadSelectedFromChat(); const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const result = { ready: snapshot.ready, noGroup: snapshot.noGroup, status: snapshot.status }; if (snapshot.ready) throw new Error(`the solo story blob loaded a story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (snapshot.noGroup?.storyId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`the make-a-group card does not name the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const blocks = Object.keys(SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter((key) => key.startsWith('story_orchestrator')).filter((key) => SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts[key]?.value); if (blocks.length) throw new Error(`a one-on-one chat holds story prompt blocks: ${blocks.join(', ')}`); if (document.querySelector('#so-hud')) throw new Error('the HUD shows in a one-on-one chat'); const sent = []; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const listener = (data) => sent.push(JSON.stringify(data)); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, listener); try { await ctx.generate('normal', {}, true); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, listener); } const leaked = sent.some((body) => /Your private knowledge|story_orchestrator|What happened so far/.test(body)); if (leaked) throw new Error('the dry-run request carries a story injection'); return { dryRuns: sent.length, leaked };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const selected = await rt.selectStory('sun-ruins'); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (selected || snapshot.ready) throw new Error('selecting a story in a one-on-one chat was not refused'); if (!String(snapshot.status).includes('Stories play in group chats')) throw new Error(`the refusal does not name the fix: ${snapshot.status}`); if (rt.getExtractionAudits().length !== globalThis.__v2703.auditsBefore) throw new Error('an extraction read ran in a one-on-one chat'); return { refused: true, status: snapshot.status };

const button = document.querySelector('#so-make-group-drawer [data-so="make-group-button"]'); if (!button) throw new Error('the drawer shows no make-a-group button'); const groupsBefore = SillyTavern.getContext().groups.map((group) => group.id); globalThis.__v2703.groupsBefore = groupsBefore; button.click(); const deadline = Date.now() + 10000; let ok = null; while (Date.now() < deadline && !ok) { ok = document.querySelector('dialog[open] .popup-button-ok'); if (!ok) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!ok) throw new Error('the make-a-group question never showed'); ok.click(); return { asked: true };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const deadline = Date.now() + 30000; while (Date.now() < deadline && !(ctx.groupId && globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId === 'sun-ruins')) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); const made = ctx.groups.find((group) => !globalThis.__v2703.groupsBefore.includes(group.id)); if (!made) throw new Error('no group was created'); globalThis.__v2703.made = made.id; const binding = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.groupStories?.[made.id]; const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const result = { group: made.name, members: made.members, open: ctx.groupId === made.id, binding, storyId: snapshot.storyId }; if (!result.open) throw new Error(`the new group was not opened: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (binding !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`the new group is not bound to the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (made.members.length !== 4) throw new Error(`the group does not hold the story's whole cast: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (snapshot.storyId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`the new group chat does not play the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = globalThis.__v2703?.made; if (!id) return { cleaned: false }; const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; if (root?.groupStories) delete root.groupStories[id]; ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const response = await fetch('/api/groups/delete', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id }) }); return { deleted: response.ok, group: id };
